user_preferences.interaction_style: Task-oriented and direct. The user provides high-level goals, and the agent is expected to formulate and execute multi-step implementation plans.
user_preferences.technical_focus: Python 3.10+ high-performance CV and desktop utility using PySide6 (Qt GUI), PyTorch, Torchvision (MobileNetV3), Hugging Face Transformers (CLIP, BLIP), BK-Trees, and SQLite. Focuses on GPU acceleration (CUDA, MPS) and UI virtualization.
user_preferences.goal_orientation: Building Tachyon Image Deduper, a premium desktop image triage workbench implementing perceptual hash searches, vector distance checks, and persistent Sticky Clusters.

project_knowledge.overview: Tachyon Image Deduper is an advanced image deduplication desktop application executing rapid perceptual hash lookups via BK-Trees, and semantic visual matches via MobileNet/CLIP/BLIP, integrating sticky groups and relation filtering.

architecture.matching_engines: Four tiers: Perceptual Hash (pHash) optimized via a fast in-memory BK-Tree using Hamming Distance, and three AI embeddings: MobileNetV3 (576 dim for speed), CLIP ViT-B-32 (512 dim standard), and BLIP (768 dim for conceptual similarity).
architecture.cluster_system: Persistent 'Sticky Clusters' are stored in SQLite. Future scans match new files against the persistent clusters. File bindings rely on ID-based mapping and absolute paths normalized with `os.path.normpath` during addition.
architecture.relations_management: User actions categorize file pairs (`FileRelation`) as Duplicate, Near Duplicate, Crop, Similar, Same Person, etc. Visibility logic dynamically filters unreviewed (`NEW_MATCH`) and annotated relations.
architecture.virtualized_ui: PySide6 GUI. Employs `QListView` model-view architecture with high-scale virtualization to display 1M+ candidate duplicate pairs seamlessly. Offers a high-contrast heatmap ('Visual Difference Mode') to isolate pixel alterations.
architecture.gpu_acceleration: `gpu_config.py` evaluates system drivers, dynamically selecting PyTorch targets (NVIDIA CUDA, Apple Silicon MPS, or Intel CPU AVX) to accelerate embedding models.

standard_decorators.@field_validator: Used inside Pydantic structures to normalize file path delimiters across Windows/Unix.

async_patterns.qt_threads: Leverages PySide6 `QThread` components inside `ThumbnailManager` and `Scanner` to offload heavy file indexing, database writes, and thumbnail scaling without locking the GUI rendering cycle.

descriptor_protocol.usage: Not used. Relies on standard Qt property mappings.

context_managers.usage: Database transaction locks and file streaming pipelines.

metaclass_usage.usage: Delegated to Pydantic and SQLite wrapper configurations.

pydantic_patterns.usage: Data models are validated using Pydantic v2, featuring strict type checks for datetime and paths.

import_patterns.lazy_heavy_imports: Heavy scientific packages (torch, torchvision, sentence_transformers) are imported dynamically inside their respective model engine handlers (e.g. CLIPEngine, MobileNetEngine) to allow rapid application launch.

core.domain: Framework core managing the local SQLite database (`database.py`), BK-Tree cache (`bktree.py`), GPU targets, and background scan workflows.
key_components: ClusterServices (cluster_services.py): Saves, merges, and auto-expands sticky clusters.
ThumbnailManager (thumbnail_manager.py): Non-blocking image resizing and cache management.

ui.domain: PySide6 user interface managing the scan configuration, virtualization lists, and cluster organizers.
key_components: QListView: Highly optimized list model preventing GUI lag.
Visual Difference Mode: High-contrast heatmap overlay comparing pixel changes.

patterns.diagnostics: Utilizes specific diagnostic scripts to verify database schema integrity (`diagnose_integrity.py`), evaluate cluster merge conflicts (`reproduce_cluster_issue.py`), and test pHash CPU performance (`verify_phash_accel.py`).

ci_cd_pipelines.status: No continuous integration workflows exist in the current setup.

database_migrations.sqlite: Managed locally via `database.py` which sets up relational tables, compound indices, and WAL settings during startup.

architectural_decisions.title: BK-Tree Perceptual Hash Acceleration
architectural_decisions.decision: Store pHash values as standard strings, indexing them in an in-memory BK-Tree to permit sub-millisecond Hamming distance lookups across millions of images.

architectural_decisions.title: Model-View UI Virtualization
architectural_decisions.decision: Unify UI duplicate triage views into virtualized Qt Models, bypassing native widget constraints to sustain 1M+ entries without memory thrashing.

architectural_decisions.title: Generic Relation Mapping
architectural_decisions.decision: Track user similarity judgments inside a generalized `file_relations` table to support crop matches, style similarity, and facial groups uniformly.

error_handling_strategy.strategy: Missing files or disk read failures are logged and bypassed. GPU out-of-memory errors fallback gracefully to CPU execution.

todo_fixme_hack_inventory.title: BKTree Cache Staleness
todo_fixme_hack_inventory.description: Modifications or deletions of files require clearing their corresponding node entries from the serialized `bktree_cache.pkl` to prevent stale matches.

white_spots: Integrating incremental model training loops to let users fine-tune similarity scores based on their matching actions.
Real-time file observer integration to update clusters instantly on disk modifications.
open_questions: Should BLIP captions undergo semantic text search to facilitate natural language search on the image repository?
Should we support remote PostgreSQL deployment to facilitate shared cluster organization across different network stations?

metadata.update_plan: Update whenever matching engines change, sticky cluster persistence schemas are updated, or SQLite structures are modified.
